headline.template: {team:CGK} {has:CGK} won 12 straight, the longest win streak in league history.
Defending champion {team:CGK} {is:CGK} 5-0, the best start to a title defense in league history.
{team:WJK} lost to {team:J/J} by 20 but would have won by starting the best lineup on the roster (135), the 3rd time this season.
{team:CGK} {is:CGK} 5-0 for the first time since 2022, just the 4th 5-0 start in league history.
Drake Maye ({team:AYP}) scored 46, tied for the 10th-highest single-game score in league history, and just the 15th player ever to score 45+.
Opponents have scored 542 points against {team:J/J} through 5 games, the most through 5 games in league history.
{team:SLS} beat {team:S/T} despite a projected 18.8-point deficit, the biggest upset by projection this season.
{team:RPA} and {team:S/T} are 4-1; teams that started 4-1 have made the playoffs 8 of 9 times.
{team:CWR} lost to {team:CGK} by 16 but would have won by starting the best lineup on the roster (115), the 2nd time this season.

more.template: {team:RPA} beat {team:GSA} for the first time since Week 12, 2021 (series: 3-10).
